proof_scope: verified bound provenance artifacts; canonical decoding was executed upstream, not repeated by this tool

field_contract.diag_selected_pack_last_id: absolute endpoint gauge; max across phase endpoints, never sum
field_contract.other_diag_fields: phase interval sums; count or canonical bytes named; grants count*131136 reserved bytes, not avoidable work
field_contract.event_fields: overlapping target events; do not sum as exclusive outcomes
field_contract.histograms: separate measured marginals; no invented joint cells
field_contract.native_fields: phase interval sums; encode/decode calls and completed-frame counts distinct; frame_bytes stored compressed bytes, admitted/fallback_bytes canonical target bytes, request/parser/raw_decoded bytes actual work, *_ns elapsed work; depth bins per successful read, not unique target populations
field_contract.file_graph: inode_record content edge to FileState, then extent descendants; metadata value roots excluded
field_contract.graph_snapshot: authenticated final immutable logical snapshot; incremental prefix union, not historical page reconstruction
field_contract.pack_provenance: successful acknowledgement range gauges+counts+single-writer custody, joined to final immutable selected locators
field_contract.units: integer count/bytes; identifiers and text explicitly named
